response: Ward K/W (Andheri West, Juhu, Vile Parle West) has billed Rs 7845240 of its Rs 8900000 monsoon road repair budget, or 88.1 percent, across 143 jobs. Of these, 25.9 percent were reopened within 30 days, and 55.9 percent met the agreed repair deadline. This is a low-lying ward (index 0.7) where flooding is common, and the city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain, so some repeat damage is expected. Still, Rs 1714069 was billed on roads under DLP, meaning the original contractor's warranty still covers them and repairs should cost the city nothing. This needs review. Also, 10 jobs were priced more than 30 percent above the rate card and should be checked. The top contractor by spend was Western Coast Asphalt Co (synthetic). Ward officers can ask for the bills and DLP status of work orders WO25-00638 and WO25-01170.
